description: CTO POLYGLOT SBOM AUTO-DETECTION V1: integrate the canonical engine's buildSbomMulti into the REAL odg-evidence-pack flow so a single normal run over a repo auto-detects npm/pypi/cargo/golang manifests and emits ONE coherent CycloneDX SBOM. Improve the existing product before adding; reuse supply-chain-attest + existing pack writers; no second engine, no duplicate registry, no new permanent primitive. Preserve the existing npm-lockfile path and JS/TS engine parity. Explicit, tested policy for malformed/ambiguous/unsupported manifests — never silently present a partial SBOM as exhaustive.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO MISSION 'ODG CTO MISSION — POLYGLOT SBOM AUTO-DETECTION V1' (objectif unique: intégrer buildSbomMulti au parcours de odg-evidence-pack).

work_item_contract.objective: In odg-evidence-pack: detectManifestSources(dir) (deterministic npm/pypi/cargo/golang manifest discovery) + buildEvidencePackFromDir(dir, opts) that composes sc.buildSbomMulti into the existing pack (SBOM+provenance+licence+report) in ONE run; CLI auto-routes a directory arg to the polyglot path while a .json lockfile arg keeps the exact existing npm behaviour.
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: CLAIM: buildSbomMulti (shipped @8ae9e58) is not reachable from a normal evidence-pack run. REPRODUCTION: odg-evidence-pack CLI only accepts a single npm lockfile JSON and calls sc.buildSbom (npm-only); buildSbomMulti is never invoked by the pack flow. ROOT CAUSE: the pack's input model is a single npm packages map. PLAN: add deterministic multi-manifest detection over a directory + a multi pack builder that reuses the engine + existing writers; route CLI by input type; keep the npm lockfile path byte-for-byte.
work_item_contract.scope: Additive functions + CLI routing in ONE bin (odg-evidence-pack.ts) + one hermetic/integration test. Engine supply-chain-attest UNCHANGED (consumed via its proven .js twin). No new parsers (pnpm/yarn/Gemfile/composer) — out of scope. dist is gitignored/regenerable ⇒ not in the committed write-set (rebuilt + exercised locally to prove the shipped bin).
invariants: Reuse the ONE canonical engine (sc.buildSbomMulti/componentsFromManifest) + existing pack writers — no second engine/duplicate registry/new primitive.
Existing npm-lockfile CLI path UNCHANGED (backward compatible).
Engine JS/TS parity preserved (engine untouched; test asserts .ts≡.js on the detected sources).
Deterministic detection (fixed ecosystem order + fixed manifest filenames).
Fail-closed + no false-exhaustive: malformed/empty/unreadable manifest ⇒ recorded warning, never a silent partial presented as complete.
acceptance_criteria: Targeted test per ecosystem (npm/pypi/cargo/golang) PASS; integration test: ONE run of buildEvidencePackFromDir over a ≥2-ecosystem temp repo ⇒ one coherent CycloneDX SBOM with the union of components + ecosystems metadata; npm-lockfile path non-regression (existing odg-evidence-pack.test.ts 11/11); determinism + dedup + malformed + unknown + unreadable cases; .ts≡.js engine parity on detected sources; tsc 0; dist rebuilt and the SHIPPED dist bin run over a polyglot temp repo in one normal execution; diff limited to write-set; committed.
stop_conditions: A change would require editing the engine / a path outside the write-set / a new primitive / a new ecosystem parser.
The npm lockfile path cannot be preserved byte-for-byte.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- runtime/bin/odg-evidence-pack.ts ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; rm -f src/runtime/evidence-pack-polyglot.test.ts runtime/missions/POLYGLOT_SBOM_AUTODETECT.json; npm run build:runtime.

objectives.goal: A single normal odg-evidence-pack run over a polyglot repo auto-detects npm/pypi/cargo/golang and emits one coherent CycloneDX SBOM, reusing buildSbomMulti; npm path preserved; fail-closed on malformed; proven end-to-end incl shipped dist bin.
done_when: All acceptance_criteria met; committed in write-set; dist bin exercised over a polyglot temp repo.

definition_of_done: odg-evidence-pack auto-detects multiple ecosystems and produces one coherent SBOM in a single normal run (source + shipped dist bin), reusing the canonical engine; npm path unchanged; malformed/unknown handled explicitly and tested; committed (no force). A general-capability improvement to the deliverable, NOT a client reference or certification.
